map_openai_params: map OpenAI TTS parameters to MiniMax TTS parameters including voice, speed, and format
transform_text_to_speech_request: build a MiniMax TTS request payload with voice settings, audio settings, and text input
transform_text_to_speech_response: decode MiniMax hex-encoded audio response and return binary audio content
validate_environment: validate MiniMax API key and set up authentication headers for the request
get_complete_url: construct the MiniMax TTS endpoint URL from base URL and model configuration
